summary: scripts/st-test builds its heavy checks (linux-gate, mail-redelivery-canaries) in one cargo target per host kept between runs (~/.cache/st-test-target, 25 GB cap, removed only while no run uses it), so a run reuses the dependencies instead of starting cold; ST_EVIDENCE_TARGET=off restores the throwaway target.

replay.detail: st-test's heavy checks only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.
